title: Motor Init Block
instructions:
Write a class called `Motor` with a primary constructor that takes:
- `name` of type `String` (read-only)
- `maxSpeed` of type `Double` (read-only)

Add an `init` block that prints:
`Motor {name} initialized with max speed {maxSpeed}`

For example, `Motor("Arm", 0.6)` should print:
`Motor Arm initialized with max speed 0.6`
hint: Use a string template inside the init block: println("Motor $name initialized with max speed $maxSpeed")
expectedOutput:
Motor Left Drive initialized with max speed 0.75
Motor Shooter initialized with max speed 1.0
